description: Write and test detection rules, such as Semgrep or CodeQL queries for vulnerable code patterns and Sigma rules for suspicious log activity, each with true-positive and false-positive samples that prove what the rule catches. Use when the user asks to write a Semgrep, CodeQL, or Sigma rule, a custom static analysis check, or a detection for a vulnerability class or attack pattern. Do not use for finding vulnerabilities by reading code (use kit-security-audit), for configuring a SIEM or deploying rules to production, or for general linting rules without a security purpose.
